readability.rationale: Domain validation lives in booking.ts with clear messages; app.ts only maps form fields to the domain call and renders; views are plain html templates.

maintainability.rationale: Dependency direction is app -> booking/views; views get a page model and never touch the database. Limits are one shared constant used by validation and form maxlength.

security.rationale: Host allowlist blocks DNS rebinding; cross-site POSTs are refused by Sec-Fetch-Site or Origin; body size capped at 10kb; urlencoded non-extended parsing plus string-only field() avoids type confusion; SQL is parameterized; user input is escaped in output (duplicate message echoes the name escaped).

reliability.rationale: Uniqueness is enforced by the UNIQUE name_key column with ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING, so simultaneous duplicate adds cannot both succeed; failed submissions re-render with values and 422.

scalability.rationale: Equipment list is one indexed-table scan per page view; adequate for a local catalogue. No pagination is in scope (J-03 exclusions).

compatibility.rationale: Forms work without JavaScript; required/maxlength attributes give browser feedback while the server remains authoritative.

tradeoffs: Requests without Origin or Sec-Fetch-Site (non-browser clients such as curl) are allowed, because CSRF needs a browser and browsers send these headers on cross-site POSTs.
